info.name: Branch Menu Management API
info.description: API collection for managing branch-specific menu availability. Allows admins to control which categories, items, and bundles are available at each branch while maintaining a single master menu.

item.name: Admin Endpoints
item.description: Admin endpoints for managing branch menu overrides. Requires admin authentication.

request.description: Get all menu overrides (categories, items, bundles) for a specific branch. Returns only items that have been explicitly overridden.

response.name: Success Response

request.description: Set availability of a category at a specific branch. When a category is disabled, all items in that category become unavailable at the branch.

response.name: Success Response
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "branchId": "uuid",
    "categoryId": "uuid",
    "isAvailable": false,
    "reason": "Category items not available at this location",
    "createdById": "uuid",
    "createdAt": "2026-01-03T19:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-01-03T19:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "message": "Category availability updated successfully"
}

response.name: Error - Cannot Enable Inactive Category

request.description: Set availability of a menu item at a specific branch. Cannot enable items that are inactive in the core menu or belong to inactive categories.
